candidates: When placing a `<Separator />` between toolbar tools, gate its rendering on the same condition as the tool(s) that follow it. If the adjacent tools are hidden in certain view modes (e.g., tools with `match: ({ viewMode }) => viewMode === 'story'`), apply the identical condition to the separator (e.g., `{viewMode === 'story' && <Separator />}`) to prevent an orphaned divider from appearing when those tools are filtered out.
